title: quickthink: local-first inference control layer for small LLMs
description: quickthink is a local-first inference control layer that gives small, on-device language models more reliable structured output by inserting a compressed plan-then-answer scaffold with latency-aware routing. It runs as zero-LLM-overhead middleware in front of Ollama-backed calls, offering three execution modes (lite, two_pass, direct), preset routing profiles, a strict plan grammar, and a canonical run/judge/validate/report eval harness for reproducible local quality checks. Built by Hermes Labs as part of its open-source reliability/assurance layer for production AI.
